review_notes: *rooted out of it* is divided with *out* on the verb and *of* on `מִן`; the competing reading gives the whole *out of* to the preposition and leaves the verb *rooted* alone, but the ASV's phrasal verb is *root out*.
The marginal note *Or, earth* was read and set aside (rule 38).
